pendentes.titulo: SSD de 500 GB ou de 1 TB: quanto espaço você usa de verdade
pendentes.alt: Dois SSDs M.2 lado a lado sobre uma bancada de madeira, com um gabinete aberto desfocado ao fundo
pendentes.pedido: Two bare M.2 NVMe solid state drive sticks lying side by side on a clean light wooden workbench, photographed from a low three-quarter angle with shallow depth of field. One drive is slightly longer than the other. In the soft-focus background, an open desktop computer case with the side panel removed. A small precision screwdriver rests near the drives. Soft natural daylight from a window on the left.

pendentes.titulo: iMac e MacBook Pro de 14 polegadas com M6: o que muda para você
pendentes.alt: Computador de mesa tudo-em-um visto de costas sobre uma mesa clara, com um notebook escuro fechado ao lado
pendentes.pedido: A slim all-in-one desktop computer seen from behind on a light wooden desk, its plain colored back panel facing the camera, with no visible logo. Next to it, a closed dark gray laptop lies flat on the desk. A small potted plant and a ceramic mug complete the scene. Soft morning daylight from a window on the right, shallow depth of field.

pendentes.titulo: Monitor piscando: cabo, placa de vídeo ou o próprio monitor?
pendentes.alt: Monitor desligado sobre uma bancada, com um cabo de vídeo desconectado enrolado à frente
pendentes.pedido: A plain black computer monitor, switched off, standing on a clean wooden workbench, seen from a slight angle. In front of it lies a coiled black video cable with its connector unplugged, next to a small desktop computer case with the side panel closed. Soft daylight from a window on the left, shallow depth of field, calm and tidy workshop atmosphere.
